blocks.p: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern institutional access to, and utilization of, the Manzili website, digital twins, interactive masterplans, showroom software, web platforms and the Connected Sales Environment (CSE) owned and operated by IT Home Solutions Company, trading as Manzili (CR 1010797640) ("Manzili", "we", "us", or "our").

If you represent an institutional real estate developer, asset management firm, or commercial enterprise, you warrant that you possess the requisite corporate authority to bind your organization to these Terms.

Manzili provides enterprise sales enablement, digital twin visualization, hardware-software integration, and transactional workflow infrastructure tailored specifically for off-plan and completed real estate portfolios within Saudi Arabia.

Unless expressly stipulated under a separate bilateral joint-venture agreement, Manzili does not act as a licensed real estate brokerage, financial escrow agent, or off-plan underwriting entity.

No entity or individual may display, replicate, adapt, or utilize these identifiers without prior written corporate authorization.

Client Asset Ownership: Enterprise Developers retain full title and intellectual property rights over their respective architectural CAD/BIM files, masterplan engineering drafts, brand assets, and proprietary unit pricing matrices provided to Manzili for digital twin ingestion.

Representational Fidelity: The 3D digital twins, interactive masterplans, lighting simulations, and virtual tours engineered by Manzili are high-fidelity architectural visualizations designed to communicate spatial layout, unit orientation, and masterplan scale.

Engineering & Construction Tolerances: While Manzili models directly from verified BIM/CAD files, physical construction is subject to civil engineering tolerances, municipal approvals, materials substitution, and contractor execution. Final unit dimensions, finishes, and spatial configurations are governed strictly by the developer's registered Wafi Off-Plan Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA).

Manzili disclaims liability for inaccuracies in developer-supplied data or government infrastructure planning adjustments.

Regulatory Alignment: When deployed within the Manzili Connected Sales Environment (CSE), digital reservation workflows, Nafath identity verification, milestone payment schedules, and SPA auto-generation are built for REGA and Wafi off-plan workflows.

Confidentiality of Requests: All architectural briefs, unit inventories, and commercial timelines submitted through our Technical Scoping form are treated as confidential and handled under the Saudi PDPL. Project files are requested only after an NDA is signed.
